title: ps formatting ".Label" method not detected
body:
### Issue Description

There's a discrepancy between docker's and podman's ps formatting. I didn't find an issue that might be covering this one

Docker (Expected behaviour):
```bash
$ docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Label \"app\"}}"
NAMES         app
nginx         
postgres   my-app
```

Podman:
```bash
$ podman ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Label \"app\"}}"
Error: template: ps:1:24: executing "ps" at <.Label>: Label is not a method but has arguments
NAMES
```

"app" is understandably my custom label

### Issue Required Info:
```bash
$ podman version
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      6.1.2
API Version:  6.1.2
Go Version:   go1.27.1-X:nodwarf5
Git Commit:   04f3aa430e6df81bea059978bc5bafbc846ba3e7
Built:        Wed Sep 16 08:48:49 2026
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64
```

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. podman ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Label \"app\"}}"

### Describe the results you received

Describe the results you received

### Describe the results you expected

Error: template: ps:1:24: executing "ps" at <.Label>: Label is not a method but has arguments
NAMES

Describe the results you expected

NAMES         app
nginx         
postgres   my-app
